bodyDigestRebaseline.note: Post-processing defects found BY this acceptance run and fixed with zero model calls, after it was recorded: (1) the D23 inventory check compared a LaTeX first line with Unicode studentWork and zeroed a fully correct answer (CP02-Q06, 2 of 6 gradings) -> notation-normalised comparison; (2) the C4 arithmetic check charged a correct step whose radical or stacked fraction the model quoted without brackets (CP03-Q08 in fix round 1; CP01-Q05) -> such lines are skipped. The model was not re-run: calls[].text, requestDigest, latency and tokens are unchanged; only bodyDigest is re-derived so G1 replays this run byte-identically through the shipped post-processing.

Second zero-call post-processing defect found BY this acceptance run: the answer-mismatch guard accepted the model's 'does not address the question' for an explicit NON-ATTEMPT (the owner's Q6 'Don't know' in legacy run 1; GS-M24-a's blank page in PARM7 runs 1 and 3) -> a non-attempt is unattempted, never a mismatch (D29). Model not re-run; only bodyDigest re-derived.

Correction of the previous entry's rule: the non-attempt test reads the model's mismatch WORK quote only (not 'all steps unattempted', which also matched the wrong-page case GS-MM-03). Net effect vs the recorded run: owner Q6 legacy r1 and GS-M24-a PARM7 r1/r3 no longer carry a false mismatch note.
